version: LOCK 16 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - wealth: Rashid's loan
builds_on: LOCK 1 trust and coins, LOCK 4 Rashid's stall, LOCK 6 Rashid, LOCK 7 opening hours, LOCK 3 What people say. Placeholders: {n}.

ask.title: A loan
ask.text: The pepper caravan leaves tomorrow and Rashid is thirty coins short. He keeps his eyes on the scales: “Lend me thirty and I will pay you back in three days. Every coin.”

riba.title: Thirty-six
riba.text: Rashid's face closes. “Thirty-six back for thirty? That is riba, friend. I would rather go without.” He turns back to his sacks.

lent.title: Lent
lent.text: Rashid takes the coins in both hands. “Three days,” he says. “You will see.”

due.title: Twenty coins
due.text: The caravan came back late and the pepper sold slowly. Rashid counts out twenty coins. “The other ten in a week. I swear it.”
due.wait: Take the twenty and give him time
due.forgive: Take the twenty and let the ten go

after.wait: Rashid lets out a long breath. “A week. Thank you.”
after.forgive: Rashid stares at you, then grips your hand across the scales. “I will not forget this.”
after.demand: Rashid goes pale, leaves the stall and comes back an hour later with ten more coins. He does not say where he got them. Later you see him leaving the inn with Mansur.

last.title: The last ten
last.text: Rashid presses ten coins into your hand and holds on a moment. “You waited for me.”
